propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment's required-reviewers rule as 'the second human approval' when it is actually a single configured identity (the release dispatcher) with self-review permitted and admin bypass available

The release runbook claims the operator must 'approve the pypi deployment when prompted' interactively, but approvals are granted non-interactively via the REST API pending_deployments endpoint, never via a UI prompt

The pypi environment gate provides identity and ref control over who can release the publish job, not independent content review; source review comes from Gerrit-reviewed main, not the environment rule

The corrected documentation must include a complete non-interactive approval recipe using the pending_deployments REST endpoint with explicit JSON body (environment_ids as array, state, comment) rather than field flags that mistype the array
.github/workflows/release.yml line 294 repeats the incorrect 'second human gate' framing in a comment and must be corrected to match the fixed runbook
